title: Loan Accounting Definition: Balance Tested After a Release, Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Definition.** The balance of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan tested against the post-release margin depends on how the loan stands on the test date: when more than 90 days have passed since the most recent installment due date, it is the principal balance plus the interest accrued on it from the day after that due date through the test date at the contract rate on an actual/365 basis, that interest rounded to cents; when 90 days or fewer have passed and billed interest remains unpaid, it is the principal balance plus that billed interest; otherwise it is the principal balance.

## Terms used

- **Most recent installment due date** — the due date of the latest installment bill on the loan.
- **Interest accrued** — the principal balance multiplied by the contract rate, divided by 100, multiplied by the days from the day after that due date through the test date, and divided by 365, rounded to cents.
- **Billed interest not yet paid** — interest billed with the loan's installments less interest payments applied, with any interest payment the member's bank returned added back.

## Balance tested by position

| Days from the most recent installment due date to the test date | Billed interest unpaid | Balance tested |
|---|---|---|
| more than 90 | any | principal balance plus interest accrued since the day after that due date |
| 90 or fewer | some | principal balance plus billed interest not yet paid |
| 90 or fewer | none | principal balance |

## Hypothetical worked figures

- Principal 73000.00 at a contract rate of 7.5, test date 120 days after the most recent due date: interest accrued is 73000.00 multiplied by 7.5, divided by 100, multiplied by 120 and divided by 365, that is 1800.00; the balance tested is 74800.00.
- Test date 91 days after the due date: more than 90 days have passed, so accrued interest is added.
- Test date 90 days after, 410.25 of billed interest unpaid: the balance tested is the principal plus 410.25.
